jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer
jobs.description_text: About the Role Sourcing is where the money is actually decided. We are expanding our Data Capture Research team in Prague with a Senior Data Scientist to work on Sourcing. Which suppliers get invited. How the event is structured. How bids that differ in price, lead time, quality, risk and carbon get compared at all. What a fair price even is. When to award, to whom, and how to split the award across suppliers. For a researcher this is unusually open ground - not one model family, but several, on the same data: Recommendation and retrieval. Supplier discovery: matching demand to the right suppliers across a 10M-node network. Forecasting and should-cost modelling. What this category, in this region, at this volume, should cost right now. Award allocation under volume, capacity and multi-sourcing constraints. Multimodal document understanding. RFPs, specs, quotes and contracts carry the actual requirements - and our T-LLM foundations already give us a head start there. Part of the work is choosing the right instrument for each - neural networks, gradient boosting, optimisation, bandits, mechanism design - instead of forcing one. Position Overview CLO Virtual Fashion에서 3D Design & Implementation Specialist를 채용합니다. [안내] 본 포지션은 패션 산업(브랜드, 벤더 등)에서 4-6년의 실무 경험을 갖춘 분들을 위한 채용입니다. CLO 소프트웨어의 기존 숙련도는 요구하지 않으며, 입사 후 새로운 IT 기술을 빠르게 습득하여 기존 패션 실무 지식과 결합할 수 있는 역량(Tech Savviness)을 중점적으로 평가합니다. CLO의 3D Design & Implementation Specialist는 CLO 소프트웨어 전문가로서 패션/디자인/패턴에 관한 지식을 바탕으로 CLO 유저를 교육하고 서포트하는 역할을 수행합니다. 아울러, 유저의 니즈를 가장 먼저 이해하여 3D 프로세스가 효과적으로 접목될 수 있도록 전문적인 컨설팅을 진행합니다. 이처럼 CLO의 3D Design & Implementation Specialist는 유저가 CLO를 더 효율적이고 가치있게 사용할 수 있도록 컨설팅, 교육, 서포트하는 역할을 수행합니다. Hiring Process [서류 검토] → [1차 인터뷰] → [CLO Software Test] → [2차 인터뷰 (+Reference Check)] → [처우 협의] → [최종 합격] (1차 인터뷰 합격자에게는 2차 면접 전, CLO 사전 학습용 교육 자료 및 임시 라이선스가 제공됩니다. 2차 면접 시 진행되는 테스트는 기존의 CLO 숙련도가 아닌, 새로운 소프트웨어를 빠르게 습득하는 학습 능력과 패션 구조에 대한 이해도를 평가하기 위한 과정입니다.) To Apply 이력서 및 경력기술서 1부 (필수) 지원동기가 담긴 자기소개서 (필수) 본인의 담당 업무 및 참여 프로젝트가 기술된 포트폴리오 (선택) (CLO를 직접 다룬 경험이 없더라도, 참여하신 프로젝트 및 업무 경력을 확인하기 위해 포트폴리오 제출을 권장합니다.)

System Monitoring: Regularly monitor IT systems and network performance, identifying potential issues before they impact end-users. jobs.description_text: The Work The Technology Workplace Services AI Solutions Engineer identifies, designs, builds, governs, and improves AI-enabled and automated solutions that strengthen TWS service delivery, employee productivity, operational efficiency, and the digital workplace experience. The role combines business analysis and process improvement with hands-on solution engineering using approved enterprise AI, automation, analytics, scripting, and low-code platforms. The incumbent works with TWS, business stakeholders, technology teams, and control functions to deliver secure, scalable, supportable, and measurable solutions with appropriate testing, documentation, change management, monitoring, and human oversight. Targeted TWS operational support remains part of the role to maintain service context, validate outcomes, and support business continuity.

jobs.title: Analyst, Credit Risk Management
jobs.description_text: The Work The Analyst, Credit Risk Management is responsible for executing independent credit risk oversight through the analysis, monitoring, and reporting of single-family residential mortgage, reverse mortgage and consumer lending portfolios, including lending tiers and segmentation by geographic region. The role plays a key part in strengthening enterprise￼wide consistency, transparency, and governance of lending risk by providing timely, data￼driven insights to Risk leadership. This role operates as part of the second line of defense and partners closely with first‑line lending and credit teams while maintaining independence of risk oversight. The role contributes to the Bank’s risk transformation agenda by enhancing analytical rigor, standardization, and reporting related to lending portfolio risk, including leveraging AI-enabled analytics and automation tools such as Microsoft Copilot Studio to improve efficiency and scalability.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Internal Audit AML/ATF/SE
jobs.description_text: Purpose of Job The Associate Director, Internal Audit will be responsible for leading the risk assessment, control identification, documentation, testing, findings and recommendation process for various operational and regulatory audits across the Bank, with a focus on Anti-Money Laundering/Anti-Terrorist Financing/Sanctions Evasion. The incumbent will also be responsible for developing and implementing audit coverage of new Bank products/strategic initiatives as assigned. This may involve auditing of certain Bank projects. Notably, the role is expected to be an expert and provide current specialized financial services knowledge with respect to AML/ATF/SE operations and regulatory requirements applicable to Credit Card, Mortgage and Deposit products. For purposes of developing meaningful audit coverage and providing consulting advice on policies and process.

jobs.description_text: Purpose of Job The Fraud Officer conducts investigations to identify, assess, decision and report on activity that indicates an exposure to financial crimes. Ensures potential threats and investigations are evaluated, documented, managed and escalated by following standard operating procedures. Provides subject matter expertise and oversight of criminal risk by following a disciplined and intelligence-based approach to detection and research of activities and events in alignment with EQ Bank’s fraud program and standards to ensure compliance as well as support trending, analysis and insights generation. L’agent ou l’agente, lutte contre la fraude, mène des enquêtes pour cerner et évaluer les activités qui présentent un risque de fraude, prendre des décisions à leur égard et les signaler. jobs.description_text: The Work As part of a growing and dynamic commercial team, the Commercial Mortgage Analyst is responsible for underwriting annual reviews for CMHC-insured commercial mortgages. The Underwriter must adhere to established policies and underwriting standards, meeting compliance and control requirements, while finding creative solutions in a timely manner in order to achieve service goals as well as annual target volumes. jobs.title: Content Manager, Reverse Mortgage
jobs.description_text: The Work The Content Manager, Reverse Mortgage is responsible for building and managing an always-on content engine that helps EQ Bank grow its reverse mortgage business across both the broker and direct-to-consumer channels. The role combines strategy, editorial leadership and hands-on execution to create a consistent flow of clear, credible and useful content across written, digital and traditional formats. This role owns content planning across the full reverse mortgage decision system: homeowners, mortgage brokers and key influencers, particularly adult children. Grounded in the reverse mortgage growth strategy, the Content Manager will translate complex product information into audience- and stage-specific content that builds permission for homeowners, reassurance for families and confidence for brokers. A central focus is the direct-to-consumer funnel, with content intentionally designed to move prospects from awareness and education through consideration, nurture, application and advocacy.

You’ll stay close to the technical work through solution design, code review, and hands-on contributions where they’re most useful. You’ll also partner with engineering leaders and product teams to prioritize platform investments, coordinate changes, and connect technical improvements to business needs.

jobs.description_text: About Fullscript We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care. That simple idea grew into a platform that powers every part of care. Today, more than 125,000 practitioners use Fullscript for clinical insights, lab interpretations, patient analytics, education, and access to high-quality supplements. Over 10 million patients rely on Fullscript to stay connected to their care plans and follow through on treatment. We build tools that make care smarter and more human. Tools that save time, simplify decisions, and help practitioners stay closely connected to the people they care for. When everything they need is in one place, they can focus on what matters most: helping people get better. This is your invitation. Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people. Join us and shape the future of care.

jobs.description_text: At Kepler Communications, we're not just imagining the future of on-demand space connectivity - we're leading it! Our mission is to provide real-time on-orbit connectivity for critical missions, enabling a new era of data-driven intelligence and innovation. With 33 satellites launched to date, Kepler operates the first commercial optical data relay constellation, enabling real-time, continuous space communications while supporting advanced on-orbit compute and hosted payload capabilities. Industry-leading technology is only part of the story. What sets Kepler apart is our team: bold thinkers, skilled builders, and passionate problem-solvers who thrive on pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in space. We believe great ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we’re committed to creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and make a global impact. If you’re ready to reach higher, move faster, and do work that shapes the future space economy - this is your launchpad. Come build the future with Kepler! What We Offer: * Competitive compensation with a robust equity plan to share in our success. * Comprehensive coverage for health, dental, and vision insurance—including dependents. * Unlimited vacation, supportive parental leave policy, and company-wide holiday shutdown. * Semi-annual company-wide parties and frequent in-office team events. * Relocation packages available for approved roles. * $1,500 annual professional development fund to support your growth. * Fully st

jobs.title: FPGA Digital Design Engineer
jobs.description_text: We’re on the hunt for a top-tier FPGA Digital Design Engineer to develop the next generation of our satellites. At Kepler, you’ll have the opportunity to work with a dedicated team of engineers building the Kepler spacecraft. You will be responsible for the design and implementation of FPGA code either with a focus on DSP algorithms to modulate and demodulate signals on board our software defined radio (SDR), or embedded systems interfacing with processors and peripherals. To be effective you will need to participate in all phases of FPGA design flow (Simulation, Synthesis, Place & Route, Timing Closure and Hardware Testing). A good understanding of the intricacies of FPGA development would make a candidate standout.

This individual will serve as a trusted advisor to the CEO, executive leadership team, and Board of Directors while leading the company's legal strategy in support of rapid growth, international expansion, government contracting, satellite licensing, spectrum management, and strategic commercial initiatives. The successful candidate will oversee both Legal and Regulatory Affairs teams and will help shape company strategy by proactively identifying legal and regulatory opportunities and risks.

jobs.title: Lead (Chief) Satellite Systems Engineer (Contingent)
jobs.description_text: Position Status: Contingent Upon Program Award As a Lead (Chief) Satellite Systems Engineer, you will serve as a primary technical authority for satellite and space-system development programs, ensuring the integrity of system design, integration, verification, and mission readiness from concept through delivery. You will translate program objectives into executable technical plans, aligning requirements, architecture, interfaces, trade studies, verification evidence, and risk decisions across a large cross-functional team. The ideal candidate has demonstrated experience delivering through at least one satellite-level program lifecycle. Experience with constellation-level architectures, multi-satellite delivery, or cross-program technical execution is a strong asset. This role requires strong systems engineering judgment, the ability to lead through ambiguity, and the communication discipline to align teams and stakeholders while balancing technical integrity with cost, schedule, risk, mission assurance, and customer expectations. This position is intended for a technical leader who can operate with credibility across engineering, program management, product assurance, suppliers, customers, and senior leadership. T1/T2 expectations emphasize ownership of technical outcomes, disciplined integration, requirements alignment, decision closure, readiness evidence, and system-wide integration readiness across multiple subsystems.

jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel – Technology & Trade Compliance
jobs.description_text: As Senior Legal Counsel – Technology & Trade Compliance, this isn’t your typical legal position. At Kepler, you’ll be embedded in a fast-moving team, helping to shape how we operate globally by balancing legal precision with bold innovation. You’ll provide hands-on legal expertise across a vast array of commercial agreements and government engagements, all while supporting cutting-edge space technology projects. As we push the boundaries of space-based connectivity, your work will ensure Kepler remains not only compliant but competitive in a highly regulated and technically complex landscape. Your decisions will directly influence how we launch, partner, build, and operate globally.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Program Manager at Kepler, you will spearhead the development and execution of mission-critical satellite systems from concept through on-orbit validation. You will drive strategic program initiatives that strengthen global partnerships and fuel our continued growth in the space sector. In this crucial role, you will lead a cross-functional team to develop and commission our Tranche-2 satellite constellation. You will serve as a key leader, working in close collaboration with our Engineering and Operations teams to ensure on-time, on-budget execution of programs from initial kickoff through operational handover. In addition to program execution, you may play a pivotal role in proposal efforts - contributing to opportunities involving the development or enhancement of satellite systems, software, satellite commissioning, or on-orbit operations. This role is ideally suited for candidates who bring good technical depth across a range of aerospace engineering disciplines paired with strong program management acumen. The successful candidate will have a proven ability to lead high-performing teams while building effective relationships with external stakeholders.

jobs.title: Office Administrator
jobs.description_text: We are looking to add an Office Administrator to our team. In this position, you will support the day-to-day administrative operations of the company by coordinating business activities, managing office operations, and providing administrative support that enables efficient business operations. This role contributes to organizational effectiveness by coordinating schedules, supporting departmental initiatives, maintaining business records, and improving administrative processes that support operational success. Working cross-functionally with employees, managers, vendors, and business stakeholders, this role supports administrative operations, office logistics, meeting coordination, travel arrangements, and business activities while ensuring services align with organizational priorities and established procedures.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Talent Acquisition
jobs.description_text: CesiumAstro is expanding its global footprint with the establishment of a new office in Munich, Germany. We are looking to add a Senior Manager of Talent Acquisition to the team who will play a critical leadership role in building and supporting this next phase of CesiumAstro’s growth in Europe. In this position, you will lead talent acquisition efforts for CesiumAstro’s Munich office, developing and executing the recruiting strategy required to build the organization from the ground up. The Senior Manager will partner closely with leadership, human resources, and functional leaders to translate business and workforce plans into an effective hiring strategy for Germany and the broader European talent market.

jobs.title: Senior Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description_text: In this position, you will play a critical role in creating a thoughtful, organized, and high-quality recruiting experience from the first candidate interaction through the interview process. You will partner closely with our Talent Acquisition team to coordinate interviews, manage candidate communications and logistics, and keep the hiring process moving. Our Senior Recruiting Coordinators play an important role in shaping how candidates experience CesiumAstro. For many candidates, you will be one of their first interactions with the company and one of the first faces they meet onsite. How we communicate, how prepared we are, and how we show up throughout the process matters. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of those details and represents our culture with professionalism, urgency, and care. This is a fast moving role that requires exceptional organization, attention to detail, and strong communication. The ideal candidate is a true team player who can quickly understand business needs, stay ahead of competing priorities, and take pride in delivering a high quality experience for candidates and internal teams alike

jobs.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner
jobs.description_text: We are looking to add a Senior Technical Recruiter to our team. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about hiring top talent to work on satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you. In this position, you will be responsible for building a pipeline of candidates to help develop leading-edge electronics for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems. You will collaborate with hiring managers and key stakeholders to identify, attract, and hire top talent in various technical disciplines within the aerospace industry. This is a multifaceted job that requires strong technical aptitude and the ability to effectively assess the technical capabilities of candidates, along with outstanding organizational skills and the ability to understand and promote the value proposition Cesium offers. Talent acquisition activities will include sourcing candidates from a variety of platforms and helping to develop high-impact recruiting strategies. You will work closely with Cesium engineering and business staff to develop and execute talent acquisition projects.

jobs.title: Spectrum Engineer II
jobs.description_text: We are looking to add a Spectrum Engineer II to our team. In this role you will support the design, development, integration, and testing of communications systems, including satellite spectrum coordination and regulatory compliance activities. This role performs communications system analyses, evaluates performance and interference considerations, and prepares technical documentation supporting system development, and licensing requirements. Using established engineering methods and regulatory guidelines, the Spectrum Engineer II resolves routine technical challenges and supports compliance with International Telecommunication Union (ITU) and Federal Communications Commission (FCC) requirements. Working cross-functionally with systems, software, RF, electrical, mechanical, integration and test, quality, regulatory, and program teams, this role supports communications systems engineering from concept development through integration, verification, and production while contributing to satellite licensing, regulatory filings, and spectrum coordination activities.

jobs.title: Scientist I/II, In Vivo Pharmacology
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo is seeking a hands-on in vivo pharmacologist to build rodent models of cardiac disease and use them to de-risk targets, screen therapeutic candidates and advance our discovery pipeline. The scientist will design, perform or manage rodent studies from target validation through hit identification, working cross-functionally with In Vitro Pharmacology, Modality Engineering, and Translational Sciences to select-advance molecules. Reporting to the Head of Cardiac Research, this role joins cardiac, neuroscience, and non-clinical scientists developing therapies for genetic heart disease and offers broad experience in multidisciplinary biopharma research.
